classification_rationale: The customer is asking for a better price to match a competitor's quote, a commercial negotiation rather than a policy-resolved matter.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thanks for flagging this, and for sticking with us over the years - that matters to us. I'm not able to set a discretionary rate myself, but I'll ask one of our managers to take a look at your account and see what we can put together for your next booking, given the history and volume you've got with us. I'll come back to you once I've heard from them.

Best regards,
Customer Service
Haapaharju Oy

commitments.description: Escalate the pricing/discount request to a manager for review, since front-line staff have no discretionary discount authority

customer_questions: Is there room to work on the pricing for our upcoming booking?

questions_addressed.question: Is there room to work on the pricing for our upcoming booking?
questions_addressed.answer_summary: Explained we can't set a discretionary rate ourselves but will have a manager review the account for a possible arrangement, and will follow up.
